zh: 提供方接入改成一个把手管一个提供方：服务新增 `registerProvider`，返回的把手一次挂上组件目录、数据源、动作、能力、市场与原生组件，子注册不写版本与提供方名；旧入口继续接受版本 2 与 3，同一侧同一个提供方只有一个活动把手，新旧入口不能混用。服务与把手都报 `supportedApiVersions`、`features` 与 `supports`，首版四项按侧给出；新把手挂的组件目录、市场组件与原生组件的 id 必须写成 `<作者域>.<名字>`，本地组件与既有记录保留扁平 id。新增 `dsh-widget-board/provider` 纯值 SDK，构造并校验注册入参。读取与动作每次 15 秒、能力 1 到 25 秒、每个提供方 8 个并发，组件、数据源、动作与能力的上限是 128、64、64、64，占满执行槽时立即拒绝而不排队；宿主按提供方记录注册数、失败、超时与可用性，设置页列出这张表。停用或卸载时这些注册与授权一起撤下，卡片保留并显示不可用，装回来恢复。
en: Provider access now runs through one handle per provider: the service gains `registerProvider`, whose handle mounts widget directories, data sources, actions, capabilities, the market and native components, and child registrations omit the version and provider name; the older entry points keep accepting version 2 and 3, one provider name has one active handle per side, and the two kinds cannot be mixed. Both the service and the handles report `supportedApiVersions`, `features` and `supports`, with four features answered per side; widget directories, market widgets and native components mounted by the new handle use ids of the form `<author>.<name>`, while local widgets and existing records keep flat ids. `dsh-widget-board/provider` is a new value-only SDK that builds and validates registration arguments. Reads and actions wait 15 seconds, capabilities 1 to 25 seconds, each provider runs 8 calls at a time, and widgets, data sources, actions and capabilities cap at 128, 64, 64 and 64; a full set of slots fails at once instead of queueing. The host records registrations, failures, timeouts and availability per provider and the settings page lists that table. Disabling or unloading a provider withdraws those registrations and grants, keeps its cards as unavailable, and restoring the provider brings them back.
